'''''Pentas lanceolata''''', commonly known as '''Egyptian starcluster''',<ref>{{cite web |title= Pentas lanceolata on the British Database of World Flora and Fauna |url= http://british-towns.net/nature/07_specie_detail.asp?GetLSID=235247 |accessdate= 2008-09-15 |archive-date= 2012-07-07 |archive-url= https://archive.today/20120707172633/http://british-towns.net/nature/07_specie_detail.asp?GetLSID=235247 |url-status= dead }}</ref> is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Rubia|madder]] family, [[Rubiaceae]] that is native to tropical Africa from Sudan to Democratic Republic of the Congo and Mozambique, as well as [[Saudi Arabia]] and [[Yemen]] on the Arabian Peninsula.<ref name=powo/> It is sometimes planted in [[Butterfly gardening|butterfly gardens]].<ref>{{cite web |title= Pentas lanceolata Floridata |url= http://floridata.com/ref/p/pen_lanc.cfm |accessdate=2008-09-15}}</ref>

==Subspecies and varieties==
Eight subspecies and varieties are accepted.<ref name = powo/>
*''Pentas lanceolata'' var. ''angustifolia'' {{small|Verdc.}} – Tanzania (Ufipa)
*''Pentas lanceolata'' subsp. ''cymosa'' {{small|(Klotzsch) Verdc.}} – Comoro Islands
*''Pentas lanceolata'' subsp. ''lanceolata'' – Eritrea to Mozambique and Saudi Arabia and Yemen
*''Pentas lanceolata'' var. ''leucaster'' {{small|(K.Krause) Verdc.}} – eastern DR Congo to Ethiopia and northern Tanzania
*''Pentas lanceolata'' var. ''nemorosa'' {{small|(Chiov.) Verdc.}} – Ethiopia, Kenya, and northern Tanzania
*''Pentas lanceolata'' var. ''oncostipula'' {{small|(K.Schum.) Verdc.}} – Tanzania, Malawi, and Mozambique
*''Pentas lanceolata'' subsp. ''quartiniana'' {{small|(A.Rich.) Verdc.}} – Eritrea, Ethiopia, Burundi, and eastern DR Congo
*''Pentas lanceolata'' var. ''usambarica'' {{small|Verdc.}} – eastern [[Usambara Mountains]] of Tanzania
